alt: An illustrated soil cutaway shows a tree root extending into a crack in a gray boulder.
An illustrated stream cutaway shows enlarged brown grains suspended in blue water above a sandy bed, with streaks suggesting flow.
Illustrated sediment examples include a pile of sand grains, angular gravel pieces and larger rounded pebbles.
A stream widens into a pool; an illustrated cutaway shows sediment piled on the bottom with a few grains above it.
An illustrated land profile shows a gently sloping grassy hill beside a much steeper hill.
Rain falls on a bare slope where small surface streams join a channel at the bottom.
A brown-skinned cartoon child with curls and glasses studies two cups of muddy water beside a blank notebook and pencil.
An inclined miniature hillside tray with soil, plants and rocks drains muddy water through an outlet into a clear cup.
An illustrated cutaway shows a root connected to a tree entering a crack in a large gray rock.
An illustrated stream descends rocky ground and branches across a broad fan-shaped deposit of sand and gravel.
Two illustrated soil trays rest on solid wedges at different slopes, with each outlet positioned above an empty collection cup.
A thick root connected to a tree runs into a narrow crack in a gray rock at ground level.
Two illustrated views show the same rock on snowy ground with ice inside a narrow crack, then a wider crack.
An illustrated stream cutaway shows sand grains underwater, with pale arrows pointing downstream above a sandy bed.
Illustrated sand grains and pale motion streaks cross a dry path beside grass bending in the same direction.
A stream enters a wider pool; an illustrated underwater cutaway shows sand piled on the bottom with grains above it.
An illustrated river winds through flat land with fresh-looking mud, shallow puddles and grass tufts beside its channel.
Three illustrated panels show roots in cracked rock, grains carried through water, and a sand deposit resting on a pool bottom.
Two illustrated rock views show water in a narrow crack on mild ground, then ice in a wider crack amid snow.
Four illustrated scenes show a shallow stream, windblown sand, rocks in and along a glacier, and loose stones below a steep rock face.
An illustrated pool cutaway shows coarse material near the inlet, finer sand farther away, and small grains still suspended in the water.
Two cartoon students with different skin tones inspect soil trays on different slopes, with empty collection cups, water pitchers and blank notebooks.
A cartoon child using a wheelchair holds two muddy-water cups while a brown-skinned classmate draws a cup outline on paper.
Two clear cups hold lighter and darker muddy water at similar levels, with sediment at their bottoms and a blank notebook nearby.
Side-by-side illustrations compare a small planted soil tray draining into a cup with a mountain landscape containing trees and a winding stream.
